rights.statement: T004 mass-generation retention package. It retains generated exterior bytes LOCALLY ONLY, under a gitignored payload directory, so a committed inventory can keep them checkable. Nothing here is conveyed, redistributed, published or served: no runtime index names this package, no promoted default selects it, and no approval envelope is widened by its existence.
